scenarios.name: Maximize while a width-compacted panel is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Modify as a compact panel button
the temporary Modify panel is open
the user maximizes the application window
the Modify commands are displayed directly in the ribbon
